facility.name: Greater Waco Early Education Center
facility.programs_provided: After School Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: One of the classrooms had an outlet that was uncovered. This was corrected during the inspection when an outlet cover was placed in the outlet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: An outlet in a pre-k class was uncovered. This was corrected during the inspection when an outlet cover was placed in the outlet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The parent handbook was missing an infant safe sleep policy, procedures for parents to communicate with the director, information on the abuse and neglect hotline and how parents can access minimum standards online, procedures for nursing mothers to nurse their children at the center, and information about the benefits of physical play and how children will do active play when the weather prohibits them from going outside. This was corrected during the inspection when this information was added to the handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The first aid kit in the transportation bus was missing a guide to first aid, tweezers, and antiseptic wipes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver was heard yelling at children during the inspection. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver was reminded that yelling is not an acceptable form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Out of ten children's files reviewed, three were missing hearing and vision screening results and two needed updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the DFPS investigation, there was sufficient evidence to show that a caregiver stepped into the bathroom to complete diaper changes, leaving the children in the classroom unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the investigation, there was sufficient evidence found to determine that adequate supervision was not provided when there were incidents where a child was bitten and the caregivers were unaware.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There were two caregivers in classrooms who did not have a cleared background check yet. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregivers left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: In the afterschool classroom, there was a bottle of cleaning supplies left within reach of children. This was corrected during the inspection when the cleaning supplies were moved to a locked cabinet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met: A classroom that had infants in it was using reduced naptime ratio. This was corrected during the inspection when another caregiver joined the classroom so that ratio was not reduced.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver who had conditions on her background check and couldn't be left alone with children was left alone with children during naptime. This was corrected during the inspection when another caregiver returned to the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat: There was an infant asleep on a boppy pillow on the floor in the infant room. This was corrected during the inspection when the infant was moved to a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat (26 TAC §746.2424)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: In one of the toddler classrooms, there was a bottle of multi-purpose cleaner sitting on a cabinet within the reach of children. This was corrected during the inspection when the cleaner was moved to a counter out of the children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat: There was an infant asleep on a boppy pillow on the floor in the infant room. This was corrected during the inspection when the infant was moved to a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat (26 TAC §746.2424)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that caregivers did not provide an adequate level of supervision to intervene and ensure the safety of children on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: One infant was observed to be swaddled in a bare crib during the inspection.  The swaddle was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Outdoor Activities: One classroom of 5 infants, ages 10 - 13 months, did not have their hands washed upon returning inside from outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Outdoor Activities (26 TAC §746.3417(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: It was observed that the fence on the playground was not secured properly.  Children were observed lifting the bottom of the chain link fence posing a safety risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that prohibited punishment was used when children were pulled or moved aggressively by the arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that caregivers used prohibited punishment when yelling at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that children were served undercooked or overcooked food at the operation on multiple occasions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that the minimum director presence of 75% was not being met.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk: Children under the age of 4 years old were observed to be served whole hotdogs during lunch.  The food was cut into small peices during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk (26 TAC §746.3317(7))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that the safety straps on one highchair were not fastened, causing a child to fall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: One infant under 12 months old was observed sleeping in a crib with a stuffed animal.  The toy was removed during the inspeciton.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Janitorial duties: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that caregivers were completing janitorial duties while responsible for the supervision of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Janitorial duties (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(C))

occurrences.finding: Crib Activities: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that infants were placed in cribs for reasons not related to sleep and when discontent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Crib Activities (26 TAC §746.2425)

occurrences.finding: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink: Two caregivers did not wash the hands of two infants after diapering the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink (26 TAC §746.3421(b))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids: One caregiver was observed wiping the noses of different children without washing their hands in between.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3415(7))

occurrences.finding: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink: One caregiver in a 12-17 month old classroom did not wash a child's hands after diapering the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink (26 TAC §746.3421(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Four infants were observed eating in highchairs without the safety belts fastened.  This was brought into compliance when the infants were buckled in their seats.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: Three caregivers were found to not know how many children they were responsible for during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Four infants were observed in highchairs without safety straps buckled.  This was corrected when the caregivers buckled the straps during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)
